approver.decision_channel: interactive Owner decision in the governed Hermes session
approver.authorised_execution: the Owner authorised the orchestration to mark PR #3 ready and perform the merge; the approval identity is the Owner, not the maker or the external reviewer

subject.embedded_scripts: archive artifacts only; MUST NOT be executed by any consumer or CI
subject.rationale: the review's M1 (exact publication set + currentness) and M2 (trusted scope/secrets, 581/581 blob ids recomputed, 0 hard findings) are complete and independently re-checkable; M3 is the single-prefix approval itself

explicitly_not_granted: any claim upgrade of PARTIAL_CHALLENGE / TEMP_CLOSED_CHALLENGE / FAIL_CLOSED
rollback: maintainer-authorised `git revert <merge-commit>` on main, or a new PR; never force-push main; a leaked credential would additionally require rotation
claim_ceiling: LOCAL_ORCHESTRATION (the approval is the Owner's; the orchestration records and executes it)
